title: 422 TRANSFER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED — the payer's daily allowance is exhausted
description: Daily transfer limits are set by Central Banks and enforced at the two chokepoints where value moves: bridge lock-mint and the cross-currency swap. The limit is checked and atomically deducted before anything moves, so a refused swap is a no-op.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway, spoke-crc. Verified in the delivered gateway (ErrTransferLimitExceeded in internal/services/transfer_limit_checker.go and the 422 mapping in cross_currency_swap_handler.go); none of it is in the platform OpenAPI document. Note the limit is quoted in wei in this message, while the max_amount a Central Bank SENDS to create the same limit is a human decimal like "100000.00" — one field name, two units, depending on direction. Limits are matched by specificity: (participant + currency) beats (participant) beats (currency) beats global.

body.error: daily transfer limit exceeded for bank-sanjose/CRC (limit: 500000000000000000000000 wei)
body.recommended_action: Contact your Central Bank to review or increase the daily transfer limit.
